- **Validation design**: 5-fold spatial (grid) nested CV, selection re-run per fold
- **Assumptions and caveats**:
  Presence/background scores are not absolute occurrence probabilities. This opportunistic record collection has no identified sampling model or sufficient causal adjustment set. Holding other predictors fixed does not establish causal identification. Range-box masking is a range-extrapolation diagnostic, not an identification test. National land background does not represent fish-accessible river habitat; reporting is restricted to the occurrence buffer.
